title: Matrix Elimination
approach: Peak <=> 3*v[x][y] >= rowsum(x)+colsum(y); a rectangle op moves that slack by a+b-3 inside, so for n,m >= 2 the whole-matrix op maximises every cell at once and the answer is the k-th smallest ceil(deficit/(n+m-3)).

techniques.label: sorting
techniques.why: the answer is the k-th smallest per-cell cost

techniques.label: binary-search-answer
techniques.why: an alternative formulation binary-searches the op count
